remarks: Welcome to CHESTERFIELD!!!...one of Stamford's prime residential communities. This gorgeous 1BD townhouse style condo is ready for its next tenant. Upon entering into a spacious foyer with a striking skylight guaranteeing an excellent first impression, get wowed by the perfect blend of spacious open and airy flow. Beautiful fully updated chef's kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, vaulted ceilings and another striking skylight. An oversized dining room with very versatile uses interconnects the kitchen and the living room. Enjoy an impressive entry into the living room with fireplace and sliders to an oversized and very private balcony for your every day outdoor enjoyment. Beautiful gleaming floors throughout. This level is completed with a tastefully updated powder room for your and your guests' convenience. Upstairs is all about your very own private relaxing oasis with fantastic bedroom suite, generous closets space and a large private bathroom with stand up shower and double vanity, even a skylight and laundry. Pet friendly complex with TWO seasonal pools...fresh and salt water...as well as security guard for your and your guests' convenience and peace of mind offers beautiful scenery for your daily walks. Walk to shops and restaurants, minutes to Metro North and Downtown Stamford. Good income and credit is a must. It's a RARE vacation style living right at your fingertips, just unpack and enjoy! Landlord prefers longer term lease.
